details:
### Description

In Open Beta build 1912, after joining a world, the first attempt to change my avatar to one of my own uploaded avatars always displays the following message:

> “This user has cloning turned off.”

This happens even though I am trying to select my own uploaded avatar, not clone another user's avatar.

Clicking the avatar a second time allows the avatar change to complete normally.

I have also seen this message appear in other situations, but I have not yet identified reliable reproduction steps for those cases.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Launch VRChat using Open Beta build 1912 in Desktop mode.

2. Join a world.

3. Open the avatar menu.

4. Select one of your own uploaded avatars as the first avatar change after joining the world.

### Actual behavior

“This user has cloning turned off.” is displayed, and the avatar does not change on the first click.

Clicking the same avatar a second time successfully changes to it.

### Expected behavior

Selecting one of my own uploaded avatars should change the avatar immediately without displaying a cloning-related error message.

### Frequency

Every time.

### Environment

Desktop mode

Open Beta build 1912
title: [1912] First avatar change after joining a world incorrectly shows “This user has cloning turned off.”
